messages:
emma_support: Customer alice@example.com reports promo code 'SPRINGFUN50' gets 'code invalid/expired' at checkout. They attached a screenshot and say it used to work last week. Account: acct_01G7Y2X. Need help reproducing / quick fix.

matt_billing: thanks — can you paste the exact code string they entered and the checkout request id if available?

emma_support: they copy-pasted from marketing email. Screenshot shows code field with 'SPRINGFUN50'. No request id yet, user says they tried twice from web UI.

alice_customer: hey! i only pasted the code from the email, it says expired even though the banner in the email states valid until Jun 30, 2026. tried in incognito too.

ingrid_devex: flagging possible whitespace/encoding issue. marketing emails sometimes introduce soft hyphens/zwsp. @matt_billing can you check the promo record?

matt_billing: looking up promo 'SPRINGFUN50'... promo_bot: Promo lookup: code=SPRINGFUN50, status=active, expires=2026-06-30T23:59:59Z, scope=global, id=promo_0a9.

emma_support: so promo active. user-facing message says expired. Could be client-side validation or hidden chars.

ingrid_devex: paste the raw payload from the frontend when they apply? If not available, ask user to paste into a plain-text editor and show hex.

alice_customer: i pasted into notepad and it showed the code. how do i get hex?

ingrid_devex: simplest: open devtools -> Application -> Local Storage -> copy the value, or paste into a small snippet: run this in console: `Array.from('SPRINGFUN50').map(c=>c.charCodeAt(0).toString(16)).join(' ')` — but first, paste the actual clipboard content into the console like `s = 'PASTE_HERE'; Array.from(s).map(c=>c.charCodeAt(0).toString(16)).join(' ')`

alice_customer: pasted and ran it, got: `53 50 52 49 4e 47 66 75 6e 35 30 20` — there's a trailing `20` (space) at end.

ingrid_devex: trailing ASCII space (0x20) — client trim should handle but maybe the UI doesn't. Any chance there are invisible chars like U+200B? if she strips whitespace does it work?

emma_support: alice, can you try removing trailing space and re-entering exactly `SPRINGFUN50` (no space) and tell us result?

alice_customer: re-entered manually, success! code applied and discount shows. thanks.

matt_billing: good catch. promo code validation on the checkout form should `trim()` input. Also server should accept trimmed token. Filing a quick bug: BUG-4521 — checkout promo input not trimming trailing whitespace, causes misleading 'expired' UX.

ingrid_devex: mitigation: i can sanitize marketing email copy to avoid trailing space and add explicit instructions. longer-term: I'll open PR to add `s.trim()` client-side and server-side normalization on apply endpoint.

emma_support: for now i credited alice manually with equivalent discount and confirmed the applied discount after they re-entered cleaned code. Logged manual credit: credit_tx_9f8 for acct_01G7Y2X.

matt_billing: noted — reversed duplicate charge check done. No invoice issues.

alingrid_devex: snippet i'll submit in PR: `const cleaned = promoCodeInput.value.replace(/\u200B/g, '').trim().toUpperCase();` also adding unit test for invisible chars.

emma_support: marking as resolved with customer. alice, please reopen if it pops again. :thumbsup:

alice_customer: all set thanks! really appreciated the fast help :heart:

matt_billing: follow-up: marketing ops, pls audit email templates for trailing whitespace in CTA code blocks.

ingrid_devex: filing task TASK-784: sanitize promo tokens in templates + add QA step.

promo_bot: Automation note: manual credit issued credit_tx_9f8 applied to acct_01G7Y2X by emma_support.

emma_support: closing thread — will link BUG-4521 and TASK-784 in the ticket.
